events.continuity_hook: Closes the remaining administrative loose ends for the already-booked Lake Erie commissioning trip without changing the flights or hotel.
events.interaction_goal: Update the site-day timing, note the badge clearance, confirm the hotel room basics, and produce a short pre-departure checklist for Monday through Thursday.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah receives the city visitor badge approval for the Thursday public-works debrief, but the plant moves Tuesday gate check-in up to 7:15 a.m. and asks him to bring a printed commissioning worksheet. The booked Detroit nonstop, compact SUV, and Perrysburg hotel still work; the only adjustments are leaving the hotel earlier Tuesday, adding the badge and worksheet items to the packing list, and confirming the hotel can provide the requested coffee maker and mini-fridge. Nothing major remains unresolved beyond watching for the seal pallet receiving note before Monday departure.
